units.source_text: 我理解了革命家的心理。

en.t: I understood the mind of a revolutionary.

units.source_text: 这位农村站长和警官围着忽闪着火苗的铁火盆，谈笑风生，

en.t: This rural stationmaster and the policeman sat around the iron brazier with its flickering flames, chatting and laughing with ease,

units.source_text: 丝毫没有预感到逼近眼前的世界的变动和他们的秩序行将崩溃。

en.t: without the slightest premonition that changes in the world were closing in before their eyes and that their order was about to collapse.
